tests.reason: Untestable (no way): Ghostty 1.4.0 parses OSC 3008 but keeps no context state and exposes no readback. In ghostty-xpli4r8n1mqrzhbgxmkj4jfbpsjsqm3m-derived-source-tar (SHA256 d692bb9b), osc.zig:1170 sends 3008 to parsers.hierarchical_context.parse, which validates the uapi start=<id>/end=<id> form and warns at hierarchical_context.zig:274; the parsed command then reaches stream.zig:2968, which lists .hierarchical_context among unimplemented OSC callbacks and only runs log.debug at :2970 (absent from the shipped binary: strings finds 0), a level main_ghostty.zig:203-211 pins off in every non-debug build. No context stack, environment, reply or public readback exists in src. A spec-valid payload leaves no observable trace, and the parser warning a malformed payload produces is payload validation, not a command-specific refusal.
